title: Next Issue State
description: Per-issue state file for the /next-issue pipeline. Written to .claude/memory/tmp/next-issue-{N}.json where N is the issue number.

version.description: Schema version. Always 2 for JSON format (version 1 was YAML frontmatter).

issue.description: Issue number from GitHub or GitLab.

branch.description: Git branch name. Set after Phase 1 (select).

plan.description: One-line plan summary. Set after Phase 2 (plan).

autonomy_level.description: Autonomy level 1-4 per orchestrate/autonomy-levels.md (#174) — the primary autonomy field. Chosen at setup or via --level N; --autonomous/--auto/NEXT_ISSUE_AUTONOMOUS=1 map to L4. Drives per-gate disposition (routine gates auto at L3-L4, escalation gates incl. plan approval auto at L4 only), with severity/critical capped at L3. Absent → L1 disposition (everything asks), unless a legacy autonomous:true is present (read as L4).

autonomous.description: Back-compat mirror of autonomy_level (autonomous == level 4), retained so the not-yet-level-aware /ship-issue keeps working; dropped by #177. Legacy reads: a file with autonomous:true and no autonomy_level migrates to L4, autonomous:false/absent to L1. Prefer autonomy_level when both are present.

plan_gated.description: Back-compat mirror derived from autonomy_level: true when this run keeps the human plan-approval checkpoint (escalation gate is human at L1-L3, and severity/critical is capped at L3 so it is always kept), false when the plan gate is auto-passed (L4 on a non-critical issue). Retained for /ship-issue; dropped by #177. No longer computed from effort labels — the level (plus the critical cap) decides it.

plan_comment_url.description: URL of the issue comment where the L4 plan was posted for traceability. Written only on the L4 plan-auto-passed path (plan_gated:false); omitted on plan-gate-kept runs (L1-L3, including a capped critical).

contexts.description: Domain contexts relevant to this issue (e.g., 'api-design', 'security').

checkpoint.description: Phase transition checkpoint. Written before context reset points to preserve key context for the next phase.

key_decisions.description: Non-obvious choices made during the phase that affect downstream work. Do NOT include things derivable from the code.

files_modified.description: Files changed so far (avoids re-scanning after reset).

files_planned.description: Files that still need to change.

warnings.description: Things discovered that the next phase should know about.

next_action.description: Explicit directive for post-reset pickup (e.g., 'Begin implementation loop: make-it-work').
